P3_execution_order: Check R_C11 membership preservation under same-side decorated false-twin replacement.
Check exact Pi preservation via color-preserving automorphism/swap.
Check polynomial discovery of decorated false-twin classes.
Record that baseline alone is insufficient if it can be identity on arbitrary frozen-authority instances.
Audit whether frozen hypotheses imply any stronger universal nontrivial exact pair quotient/factorization satisfying all P3 requirements.
If such a theorem is not established, return P4_PAIR_STRUCTURE_UNRESOLVED. Do not return P3_FALSE.

decorated_false_twin_definition.interpretation: The transposition of two class members is an automorphism of the complete decorated frozen instance.

baseline_requirements: R_C11 membership preserved under replacing either endpoint by a decorated false twin on the same side.
Pi(y,y') preserved exactly under the corresponding color-preserving automorphism.
Classes computable in polynomial time by decorated neighborhood keys.
Class summary size independent of class multiplicity.
P3_universal_requirements: At least two distinct ordered survivor pairs are genuinely merged whenever the claimed universal quotient/factorization applies.
Summary size independent of represented-pair count.
Identity classes, n^2 listing, equal Sigma, equal rows/columns, local H8 shape, list pattern, color orbit, or finite empirical Pi equality are insufficient.
